scripts.check: npm run test:ts:node && npm run cucumber:node
scripts.check:ruby-legacy: npm run test:ts && npm run cucumber
scripts.cucumber: npm run build && cucumber-js --config cucumber-js.mjs --require "features/support/**/*.js" --require "features/step_definitions/**/*.js" --format progress "features/**/*.feature.md"
scripts.cucumber:node: npm run build && QNI_SKIP_RUBY_FALLBACK_SCENARIOS=1 cucumber-js --config cucumber-js.mjs --require "features/support/**/*.js" --require "features/step_definitions/**/*.js" --format progress "features/**/*.feature.md"
